hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233744 (all sites STANDARD/GROUP STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 25 sites plus a group site (site 28, up to 80 people) and 3 picnic sites. Gravel spurs; the Forest Service gives an average spur of 16 x 50 ft, while recreation.gov's catalog rates sites 20-45 ft (five pull-through). Some sites lie in open meadow along the shoreline.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/hood-creek-campground ('Camp sites: 25, 1 group and 3 picnic', 'Average Parking Spur: 16 X 50', 'Some campsites lie in open meadows along the shoreline') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233744 (Max Vehicle Length 20-45, Driveway Entry 'Pull-through' on 5), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Hand-pump drinking water, trash and recycling, food storage lockers. Boat ramp and beach on site; kayak rentals at the host site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/hood-creek-campground ('vault toilets, drinking water and trash collection. A boat ramp is located on-site', 'No RV Dump Station is located in any of the USFS campgrounds managed by ExplorUS in the Custer-Gallatin National Forest.', 'There are NO Shower facilities located at this campground.', 'Kayak rentals are offered at the Hood Creek Campground host site') + recreation.gov amenities ('Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Recycling', 'Food Storage Locker', 'Beach Access'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Concession-run (ExplorUS on recreation.gov; the Forest Service page names Rocky Mountain Recreation Company). Every site is reservable on recreation.gov until 4 days before arrival; 16 consecutive nights. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233744 (catalog: all sites reservable; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, reservationCutOff 4) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/hood-creek-campground ('Check in 2:00 PM - Check Out 12:00 PM/Noon'), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF campground on the banks of Hyalite Reservoir, ~17 mi S of Bozeman up Hyalite Canyon Rd at ~6,700 ft; some sites in open meadow on the shoreline, others among pine and fir. Hyalite Peak Trail nearby. --Claude
